headline: Best day of the week — chest-high prime-angle morning with offshore wind.
today: This is the standout. Sets to 2.5ft on a prime SSE angle, dawn offshore NNW going light NE through the morning — clean and fun for most boards. Ride it before the SSW cross-on creeps in for the afternoon. If you're going to make the drive this week, today's the day.

daysToWatch.note: Fading fast to waist-high but light morning winds keep it clean if you're already out here.
More size on paper to 3ft but it's short-period S junk under 18mph cross-off wind. Looks bigger than it surfs.
